def solve(grid):
    import copy
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Divider lines are uniform, non-background rows/columns.
    hr=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=0]
    vc=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=0]
    rs=[]; start=0
    for cut in hr:
        if start<cut: rs.append((start,cut))
        start=cut+1
    if start<h: rs.append((start,h))
    cs=[]; start=0
    for cut in vc:
        if start<cut: cs.append((start,cut))
        start=cut+1
    if start<w: cs.append((start,w))
    out=copy.deepcopy(grid)
    def tile(i,j):
        a,b=rs[i]; c,d=cs[j]
        return [row[c:d] for row in grid[a:b]]
    def colors(t): return {x for row in t for x in row if x}
    def reflect(t, vert=False, horiz=False):
        z=[row[::-1] if horiz else row[:] for row in t]
        if vert: z=z[::-1]
        return z
    for i in range(len(rs)-1):
      for j in range(len(cs)-1):
        ts=[tile(i,j),tile(i,j+1),tile(i+1,j),tile(i+1,j+1)]
        if len({len(t) for t in ts})!=1 or len({len(t[0]) for t in ts})!=1: continue
        csx=[colors(t) for t in ts]
        present=[k for k,s in enumerate(csx) if s]
        if len(present)!=3 or any(len(csx[k])!=1 for k in present): continue
        col=next(iter(csx[present[0]]))
        if any(next(iter(csx[k]))!=col for k in present): continue
        missing=next(k for k in range(4) if k not in present)
        # Infer the canonical top-left tile from any present tile.
        bases=[]
        for k in present:
            r,c=divmod(k,2)
            bases.append(reflect(ts[k], vert=bool(r), horiz=bool(c)))
        if not all(b==bases[0] for b in bases[1:]): continue
        r,c=divmod(missing,2)
        fill=reflect(bases[0],vert=bool(r),horiz=bool(c))
        ti,tj=i+r,j+c
        y0,y1=rs[ti]; x0,x1=cs[tj]
        for y,row in enumerate(fill):
            for x,v in enumerate(row): out[y0+y][x0+x]=v
    return out

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_cuts = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0]
    col_cuts = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0]

    def segments(length, cuts):
        result, start = [], 0
        for cut in cuts:
            if start < cut:
                result.append((start, cut))
            start = cut + 1
        if start < length:
            result.append((start, length))
        return result

    rows = segments(h, row_cuts)
    cols = segments(w, col_cuts)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    def get_tile(i, j):
        y0, y1 = rows[i]
        x0, x1 = cols[j]
        return [row[x0:x1] for row in grid[y0:y1]]

    def colors(tile):
        return {v for row in tile for v in row if v != 0}

    def reflect(tile, vertical=False, horizontal=False):
        result = [row[::-1] if horizontal else row[:] for row in tile]
        return result[::-1] if vertical else result

    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            tiles = [get_tile(i, j), get_tile(i, j + 1),
                     get_tile(i + 1, j), get_tile(i + 1, j + 1)]
            if len({len(t) for t in tiles}) != 1 or len({len(t[0]) for t in tiles}) != 1:
                continue
            tile_colors = [colors(t) for t in tiles]
            present = [k for k, c in enumerate(tile_colors) if c]
            if len(present) != 3 or any(len(tile_colors[k]) != 1 for k in present):
                continue
            color = next(iter(tile_colors[present[0]]))
            if any(next(iter(tile_colors[k])) != color for k in present):
                continue

            bases = []
            for k in present:
                r, c = divmod(k, 2)
                bases.append(reflect(tiles[k], vertical=bool(r), horizontal=bool(c)))
            if not all(base == bases[0] for base in bases[1:]):
                continue

            missing = next(k for k in range(4) if k not in present)
            r, c = divmod(missing, 2)
            fill = reflect(bases[0], vertical=bool(r), horizontal=bool(c))
            y0, _ = rows[i + r]
            x0, _ = cols[j + c]
            for dy, line in enumerate(fill):
                for dx, value in enumerate(line):
                    out[y0 + dy][x0 + dx] = value
    return out
'''
